title: The rationals are a constructive field whose apartness is tight
statement: Rat.fieldS : AlgS.Field is the decidable-equality instance of the constructive field record. Because equality on the constructed rationals is decidable, apartness is just disequality -- Rat.apart a b := Eq Rat a b -> False -- and the whole apartness layer is Rat.lt_trichotomy plus one Eq.rec transport (Rat.ne_of_lt). The setoid cost is ZERO: AlgS.CommRing.ofAlg Rat.commRing supplies all 23 ring fields with equiv := Eq Rat, and only the six field-specific arguments are proved. Rat.fieldS_isTight then proves AlgS.Field.IsTight Rat.fieldS: Not (apart a b) implies equiv a b, i.e. stability of equality, by trichotomy with Rat.ne_of_lt in the two strict branches. This is the half of the tightness story the constructed REALS cannot supply, and it is what makes AlgS.Field.IsTight a non-vacuous predicate rather than a decorative one.

evidence.supports: Rat.ne_of_lt, apart, apart_symm, apart_cotrans, apart_compat, mulInvEx, fieldS and fieldS_isTight admit with empty footprints, all on FIRST submission. The suite checks that Rat.fieldS's rendered type is exactly AlgS.Field; that the AlgS.Field selectors carrier/zero/one/mul/add/neg/apart at Rat.fieldS reduce by def_eq to the rationals' own constants, and that apart is NOT def_eq to Eq Rat -- apartness is data, its NEGATION; and that fieldS_isTight's rendered type names both AlgS.Field.IsTight and Rat.fieldS. One negative control must be REFUSED: cotransitivity's first branch introduced on the RIGHT disjunct, where a < c says nothing about c and b.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release -- rat_prelude::field_setoid_instance --test-threads=4 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 5 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned count is 5. The load-bearing member is the def_eq assertion that AlgS.Field.apart Rat.fieldS is not Eq Rat -- the two have the same type, so nothing else separates a field whose apartness is its equality from one whose apartness is real.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel rat_prelude::field_setoid_instance, lane vector-spaces-field, ADR-1627 (roadmap W3-2).

notes: Rat.mul_inv_cancel_of_ne_zero already existed and is what discharges mulInvEx: the rationals' inverse is TOTAL, so the existential's witness is a plain term Rat.inv a. That is exactly the case the constructed reals cannot copy, and the contrast is the whole content of ADR-1627.
